courses.area: Architectural studies, interior architecture, landscape architecture.

courses.summary: The UNSW College Diploma of Architecture is your direct pathway to second year at UNSW Sydney - one of the world's top 20 universities.* Designed for students who narrowly missed direct entry, this 12-month program offers a supportive and practical introduction to university life with smaller classes, personalised academic support, and first-year equivalent courses developed in collaboration with UNSW Sydney. You'll gain the design thinking, technical skills, and creative confidence to thrive in a range of architecture disciplines, while building your portfolio through studio-based learning. You'll explore how people, place and purpose intersect in the built environment, and gain hands-on experience with digital tools and industry-relevant approaches. Whether you're interested in architectural studies, interior architecture or landscape architecture, this Diploma gives you the foundation you need and a direct path to your UNSW degree. Upon successful completion of the Diploma and meeting entry requirements, you'll progress into second year at UNSW Sydney where you can study: Bachelor of Architectural Studies Bachelor of Interior Architecture (Honours) or Bachelor of Landscape Architecture (Honours) * QS World University Rankings, 2026.
courses.careers: Landscape architect, architect, architectural technician, interior and spatial designer, building surveyor, town planner, production designer.

courses.summary: Start your journey in tech with the UNSW College Diploma of Computer Science, a 12-month program that leads you straight into second year of the Bachelor of Science (Computer Science) at UNSW Sydney. Designed for students who narrowly missed direct entry to UNSW, the Diploma offers a full first-year university experience in a supportive environment. You'll benefit from smaller class sizes, personalised academic support, and first-year equivalent courses developed in collaboration with UNSW's leading Computer Science faculty. In this Diploma, you'll learn about the design, construction and uses of computer systems with an emphasis on the basic principles behind computing tools, operating systems, compilers and translators, and computer hardware. Upon successful completion of the Diploma and meeting the required progression criteria, you'll be ready to take your place in the second year of the Bachelor of Science (Computer Science) at UNSW Sydney. UNSW Sydney is ranked #1 in Australia and #25th globally for Engineering and Technology* and is home to Australia’s most employable graduates^, six years in a row.
